mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a necessity for the achievement of results."
Adequate resources are a necessity for the achievement of results.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with keeping records of school activities and using such record to assess or appraise institutional performance in relation to the achievement of predetermined objectives."

Accountability in education is concerned with keeping records of school activities and using such record to assess or appraise institutional performance in relation to the achievement of predetermined objectives.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an obligation of an individual to perform the functions assigned to him to the best of his ability and in accordance with stated rules and regulation."
Responsibility in the organisation is an obligation of an individual to perform the functions assigned to him to the best of his ability and in accordance with stated rules and regulation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the body of knowledge devoted to the understanding of human and organisational behaviour."
Behavioural management is the body of knowledge devoted to the understanding of human and organisational behaviour.

Among such organs are the National primary education Commission (NPEC), the National Commission for Colleges of Education (NCCE) and the National Universities Commission (NUC).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of bringing men and materials together in order to ensure effective and functional teaching and learning in school."
Educational Management is the process of bringing men and materials together in order to ensure effective and functional teaching and learning in school.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statement of income and expenditure."
A budget is a statement of income and expenditure.

records is one of the important aspects of school administration.
